title: Haaye Zahra(sa) Ka Musalman
body:
Haye Binte Payambar.. 4
Haye Zahra(sa)
Haaye Zahra(sa) Ka Musalma Ghar Jalane Aaye Hain
Mustafa(saww) Ko Qabr Me Bhi-2 Yeh Rulane Aaye Hain
Isko Pehchano Aye Logo Yeh Hai Binte Mustafa(saww)-2
Qabre Zahra(sa) Ko Ali(as) Kyukar Chupane Aaye Hain
Kal Jo Bakhkin Keh Rahe The, Ahmade Mukhtar Ko-2
Bandh Kar Rassi Me Haider(as), Ko Le Jaane Aaye Hain
Haaye Dar Jalta Huwa Jab, Sayyeda(sa) Par Aa Gira-2
Aag Se Hasnain(as) Hi Maa Ko Bachane, Aaye Hain
Baba Jaa'n Mujhko Satana, Hai Satana Aapko-2
Jante Hain Phir Bhi Yeh Mujhko Satane, Aaye Hain
Jis Jagah Par Bhi Huwa Hai, Zikr Zahra(sa) Ka Wahan-2
Anmbiya Bhi Farshe Majlis Ka Bichane, Aaye Hain
Aapse Dawa Wafadari Ka Jo Karte Rahe-2
Aaj Lekar Woh Mere Ghar Taziyane, Aaye Hain
Teri Zahra(sa) Apne Ghar Me, Ro Nahi Sakti Tujhe -2
Haaye Kaise Ghurbato Ke Yeh Zamane, Aaye Hain
Matmi Halqon Ki Surat Fatema(sa) Yeh Matmi -2
Jaan Apni Naam Par Tere Lutane, Aaye Hain
Sochkar Rota Hai "Qambar ", Kaise Kalmago The Woh -2
Kaabe Ka Jo Ghar Tha Kaaba Woh Girane,Aaye Hain
